**Current workspace — v0.1.0**
One destination: competition sidebar and scrolling question list. Original exam order; 10 questions/page. First available competition selected automatically. Name · Year · Position/exam; desktop ellipsis and tooltip; phone labels wrap. Desktop Ghost reveal on hover/focus; phones use an overlay drawer. Empty competition list shows a message only; navigation failure offers manual Retry. Interface: pt-BR and en. No additional routes. Exact breakpoint, data source and locale controls require technical validation.
